question: Has Arjuna heard this with one-pointed mind and lost delusion?
premises: the Lord asks whether this has been heard
the hearing is with one-pointed mind
the Lord asks whether ignorance-delusion is destroyed
inference: The verse closes by testing Arjuna's attentive reception and removal of delusion.
plain_english: Has this been heard by you, O son of Pṛthā, with one-pointed mind? Has ignorance-delusion been destroyed for you, O winner of wealth?
